flags.message: The distribution-moment cell carries an as-stored snapshot with null cutoff and cut_kind rather than a demonstrably moment-bounded baseline. Although named 2026-10-05.json, its latest listed proceeding is September 9 and source creation date is September 24; it lists a September 28 conference. I used the frozen one-distribution state, inferred no hold or survival from later silence, and did not seek or encounter this petition's outcome. The reply is docketed but its text is not provisioned.
